items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: His saxophone players and had one Cuban trumpet player, Hot Lips Garcia, and myself. ... I played lead in that band. Garcia was the soloist.

ctx.x: His saxophone players and had one Cuban trumpet player, Hot Lips Garcia, and myself. But we were the soloists. (well, sort of.) No, I played lead in that band. Garcia was the soloist. But the saxophone section -- was all American. Had Joe Hayman in there, Greeley Walton, and this guy that -- I forget his name now. They had a great saxophone section, and all American, they had a certain amount -- the writers would write mostly swing music for the band.
